Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy Lead India to Thrilling 4-Wicket Win Against New Zealand in 2nd T20I

04 Nov 2026, 02:16 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysFans can verify official match reports and scorecards through authorized cricket boards and sports broadcasting networks.

In this article
  1. Match Summary
  2. New Zealand Innings

  4. Brief Scores

Match Summary

India secured a dramatic four-wicket victory against New Zealand in the second T20I on Saturday, taking a 2-0 lead in the five-match series. Chasing a target of 181, India overcame a precarious position of 112/6 in the 15th over to reach 181/6 in 19.5 overs.

New Zealand Innings

Batting first, New Zealand posted 180/5 in their 20 overs.

  • After slipping to 41/3 in the powerplay, Glenn Phillips and Bevon Jacobs staged a vital recovery.
  • The pair added 116 runs for the fourth wicket.
  • Phillips scored 70 off 43 balls (four fours, four sixes), while Jacobs contributed 56 off 46 deliveries (five fours, one six).
  • Arshdeep Singh was the pick of the Indian bowlers with 2/33, while Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Prince Yadav, and Nitish Kumar Reddy claimed one wicket each.

India's Chase and Dramatic Recovery

India's chase hit turbulence as New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner dismantled the middle order, returning exceptional figures of 4/21.

  • Naman Dhir provided a useful 31, but wickets tumbled, leaving India struggling at 112/6.
  • Requiring nearly 70 runs in the final five overs, Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy engineered an unbroken rescue partnership.
  • Tilak remained unbeaten on 51 off 26 balls (six fours, one six), and Nitish chipped in with an unbeaten 26 to seal the win with one ball to spare.

Brief Scores

  • New Zealand: 180/5 in 20 overs (Glenn Phillips 70, Bevon Jacobs 56; Arshdeep Singh 2/33)
  • India: 181/6 in 19.5 overs (Tilak Varma 51*, Naman Dhir 31, Nitish Kumar Reddy 26*; Mitchell Santner 4/21)
